person_relationships.description: Lê Minh Hưng is the Prime Minister who nominated Hoàng Thanh Tùng as Minister of Justice in April 2026
Trần Thanh Mẫn is the Chairman of the National Assembly who presided over the session confirming Hoàng Thanh Tùng as Minister of Justice

political_stances.stance_content: As Chair of the National Assembly Committee on Legal Affairs (2019-2025), he oversaw the merger of the Committee on Legal Affairs and the Committee on Judicial Affairs into the unified Committee on Legal and Judicial Affairs in February 2025, streamlining legislative oversight.
Member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam for two consecutive tenures (13th and 14th), with advanced political theory training (Cao cấp).

major_achievements.achievement: Elected as Member of the Standing Committee of the National Assembly and Chair of the Committee on Legal Affairs with 440/451 votes in favor, demonstrating strong parliamentary confidence
Elected as Member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam at the 13th National Party Congress, and re-elected at the 14th Congress in January 2026
Led the restructuring of two National Assembly committees (Legal Affairs and Judicial Affairs) into the unified Committee on Legal and Judicial Affairs, becoming its first Chair
Appointed as Minister of Justice by the 16th National Assembly for the 2026-2031 term, succeeding Nguyễn Hải Ninh

biography_summary: 黄青松（Hoàng Thanh Tùng），1966年12月25日出生于越南义安省义城县（今嘉乐社），京族，无宗教信仰。法学硕士学历，高级政治理论水平。2000年5月19日加入越南共产党。黄青松长期在国会法律委员会系统工作，连续四届当选国会议员（第十三至十六届）。2011年起担任第十三届国会法律委员会常务委员，2016年任第十四届国会法律委员会副主任委员兼国会副秘书长。2019年11月当选国会常务委员会委员和法律委员会主任委员。2021年1月在越共十三大上当选中央委员会委员，2026年1月越共十四大连任中央委员。2025年2月，在国会机构精简改革中，法律委员会与司法委员会合并为法律与司法委员会，黄青松出任首任主任委员。2026年4月8日，经第十六届国会第一次会议批准，被任命为司法部部长，任期2026-2031年。

collection_meta.notes: Hoang Thanh Tung is the incumbent Minister of Justice of Vietnam, appointed April 8, 2026. Born December 25, 1966 in Nghe An province. Law master's degree, advanced political theory. Four-term National Assembly delegate (13th-16th). Former Chair of NA Committee on Legal Affairs (2019-2025) and Legal & Judicial Affairs (2025-2026). CPV Central Committee member (13th, 14th tenures). Wikidata Q49054233 confirmed. Detailed career timeline available from multiple official government sources.
